desc: Derive/verify the invariant: birth times = first occurrences of prefix positions, and smoke at (R,C) at t+0.5 ⟺ P_t − (R,C) ∈ {P_0,…,P_t}; hand-checked on "NNEEWS" with (R,C)=(−2,1) → 001010.
Write the complete O(N) program (fast stdin read, incremental prefix position, encoded-int set, single stdout write, tight loop with local aliases).

Verify code against samples: Sample 1 → 001010 ✔, Sample 2 (N=10, R=1, C=2, NEESESWEES) traced fully → 0001101011 ✔, Sample 3 prefix ✔; encoding injectivity confirmed (|components| ≤ 2N < M/2 with M = 4N+5); edge cases N=1, large |R|/|C| (all zeros), repeated paths handled.
